name: The Morning Glow - Handwritten Collection
short_description: A seafront Handwritten Collection hotel on Nha Trang's coastal road with smart in-room technology and private balconies, holding a 4.2/5 ALL Rating (102 reviews).
ai_summary: The Morning Glow - Handwritten Collection is a seafront hotel on Nha Trang's scenic coastal road (Pham Van Dong Street), blending urban design with a seaside setting. Rooms feature smart in-room technology for controlling lighting and ambiance, with private balconies offering ocean or city views. The property holds a 4.2/5 ALL Rating from 102 reviews on its own Accor page. No star rating is displayed on the property's own page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
